text.title: 水边的一只小生命
text.situation:
小径沿河岸通向池塘。岸边浮着叶片，下面一只小生物在动。乔原本还在想它是否活着，随后它游走。露丝指向池塘图上的蝾螈：它是两栖动物，也是脊椎动物。成年后可在水和陆地生活。往前一点的牌子介绍池塘是候鸟停歇点。无需追赶动物来更好观察。

玛雅：叶片自己在动吗？
乔：它浮在水上，小动物在下面移动。
露丝：从这里观察。鸟需要安静地方休息。
她们留在平台上，看涟漪到达边缘。

paragraphs.en: The path followed the river bank to a pond. A leaf floated near the edge, and a tiny creature moved beneath it. Jo wondered whether it was alive until it swam away. Ruth pointed to a newt on the pond diagram: an amphibian and a vertebrate. Its adult life can be amphibious, with time spent in water and on land. Farther along, a sign described the pond as a resting place for migratory birds. Nobody had to chase an animal to see it better.

paragraphs.en:
Maya: Did the leaf move by itself?
Jo: It was floating on the water. The little animal moved underneath.
Ruth: Watch from here. The birds need a quiet place to rest.
They stayed on the platform as ripples reached the edge.
